english: Grants 15 Reload Speed and 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration while your Magazine has Ammo remaining and is at or below 50% capacity.

source.text:
2 Piece | Fanfare

While Ammo = ≤50% of Magazine AND Ammo ≠ 0:
+15 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

Does not trigger at 0 Ammo. rip bows, GLs, and Rockets
